title: [contextual difference] ROV status changes from inoperable to back online
description:
Status: definitive. Type: contextual difference. Check family I: semantic value comparison.

The incident report says the ROV was completely inoperable after the October 8 failure; the field journal says on Oct 10 that the ROV is back online. These are successive dated states of the same equipment, and the later statement supersedes the earlier one.

Verification: The evidence describes successive states of the ROV: it became inoperable after the October 8 failure, and the journal reports it back online on October 10. The incident report also says repairs were completed by 08:00 on October 10 and the vehicle was cleared for subsequent operations, explaining the change. Explanation considered: The incident report states that repairs were completed by 08:00 on October 10 and the ROV was cleared for subsequent operations. Possibly resolving evidence: Incident_Report_ROV.docx, section 'Downtime & Resolution': “Repairs were completed by 08:00 on October 10, and the vehicle was cleared for subsequent operations.”
